stories.summary: PHOTO/MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI The National Social Security Fund (NSSF) has declared a 22.53 per cent interest rate on members’ savings for the financial year ended June 30, 2026. The 22.53 percent is the annual interest rate declared on members’ savings after NSSF has invested the money and generated returns. NSSF is a long-term fund.

stories.summary: PHOTO/MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI Euromonitor International estimates that illicit alcohol’s share of total alcohol consumption in Uganda rose from 64.5 percent in 2020 to 67.3 percent in 2024. Uganda is estimated to have lost Shs3 trillion in tax revenue to illicit alcohol in 2024. Third, the government must collaborate with formal industry players.

stories.summary: Reduced U.S. climate financing and financial strain tied to global conflicts have left fewer companies with spare cash to spend on carbon credits. PHOTO/ MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI East Africa is excited about carbon credits now. Five years ago, a developer could set up a carbon project, get it checked by an outside auditor, and start selling credits without much trouble.
